notes.title: ✨GRAPHICS UPDATE✨
notes.notes:
Sail VR ✨Graphics Update✨⭐New Features⭐
- 🌊 New Waves: Sail on dynamic seas, ranging from calm, peaceful waters to mountainous waves! 

- ☀️ New Skybox: Enjoy a Custom Made skybox tailor made for Sail VR!

- 💡 Lighting Tweaks: New lighting tweaks integrated with the new waves & skybox as well as for immersion.

- ⚙️ Optimizations: Optimizations to allow for a better & smoother FPS on Quest headsets.

- ✨ Feature Polishes: Many small polishes were made based upon what you told us.

- 🦜 #PortOutOfWorld: port & world are once again separated, allowing for fuller rooms in each scene.

- 🛠️ Bug Fixes: many bug fixes. Thank you for reporting them! You've been a huge help!

- 🎵 New Music: New Music by Tijn Vann Givst


Report any issues or bugs to suport@redteam.games

Check out the Trailer 👇

The Sail Player database was hacked and we had to take it offline in order to fix something. This update fixes those vulnerabilities.

IMPORTANT NOTICE TO HACKERS 

If you are able to find a vulnerability in Sail that allows you to access & change values in our database please contact us. (email support@redteam.games or discord: garett_c)

If you are willing to show us the exploit and not use it maliciously we promise no legal action against you and potential Monetary compensation for showing us the exploit

- Garett

notes.title: Multiplayer Update!!!
notes.notes:
Multiplayer has Arrived to Sail VR!!!  

🏴‍☠️ Multiplayer Update: 1.8.1 

Sail is in Early Access / Beta, and may contain bugs

Rally your crew and set Sail in the NEW Sail VR Multiplayer experience. 

Sail is an open world, multiplayer, VR pirate adventure game inspired by games like Sea of Thieves & Assassin's Creed Black Flag. 

Sail Multiplayer is loaded with repayable features including: 

- Social Lobbies: Join forces with friends or make new ones in the pirate social lobbies. 

- Player Customization: Customize your pirate look with hats, eye patches, jackets, beards & more!!! 

- PvP Pirate Combat: Battle other crews in in exhilarating ship-to-ship combat or sword duels.

- PvP Combat: Face off against cunning NPCs on land and sea. 

- XP & Leveling: Level up as you plunder and earn your pirate reputation

- Treasure Hunting: Solve riddles and puzzles to be lead to buried loot. 

- Extraction Game Mode:  Outwit and outplay other crews for treasure and glory but you only get to keep it if you make it out alive.

With all these features and more on the way there's only one question left to ask. . .

Arghhhh you ready to Set SAIL????
